summary: Smoother Files, quieter idle agents and recovery-verified updates.

improvements: The private agent includes the current conversation, connector and hosting improvements.
Files keeps its dedicated workspace with clearer folders and reversible actions.
An approved update preserves saved files, conversations and settings.
fixes: Moving a file keeps the folder picker open on touch and desktop screens.
Conversation recovery avoids repeating a command whose outcome is uncertain.
Wallet preserves your reading position when your session renews.
Background status refreshes no longer wake a sleeping agent.
security: Existing agents require recovery-qualified compatibility and exact owner approval before installation.
Computer Use and unqualified hosting moves remain unavailable.
